sections.heading: Overview

sections.content:
The objective of this procurement is to establish a reliable and sustainable supply arrangement for movable median components that:
Supports the ongoing operation and maintenance of movable median barrier systems. Ensures the timely availability of critical components. Meets TfNSW's quality, safety and performance requirements. Minimises operational and supply chain risks. Delivers value for money for TfNSW.
Please note that TfNSW reserves the right to award contracts to one or more suppliers as a result of this procurement process.
sections.heading: Project goals

sections.content:
The scope of work includes the fabrication and supply of movable median components in accordance with the specifications, drawings and requirements set out in the RFP.
Components may include, but are not limited to:
Vertical Pin Joints
Slip Joints
Pivot Anchors
End Frustums
Trailing Modules
Control Modules
Drive Modules
The successful supplier will be required to manufacture and supply components that comply with TfNSW's technical, quality, safety and delivery requirements.
